description: 10-part pilot BOM for Person A's unit tests. ALL 10 parts have full manual ground-truth calculations (mass, material cost, process cost, fastener cost, total cost) worked by hand. v2 CORRECTION (2026-08-22): PILOT_004 material/total cost fixed (was EUR2.80/9.79, corrected to EUR2.79/9.78) after Person A flagged a rounding discrepancy during A4 validation. All process/print times are engineering-judgement estimates, not sourced - flagged per-part in calc_notes.

manual_calculation.calc_notes: Mass = 0.000024 m3 x 2700 kg/m3 = 0.0648 kg. Material cost = 0.0648 x EUR39.20/kg. Process time is an ESTIMATE (15 min for profile cut + 4 holes) - not from a source, flagged as engineering judgement.
Mass 0.15736 kg x EUR44.24/kg. Process time ESTIMATE (20 min, thicker plate + precision holes) - engineering judgement, not sourced.
Mass 0.0471 kg x EUR8.86/kg. Process time ESTIMATE (3 min cut+bend) - engineering judgement, not sourced. Fasteners: 2x BOLT_M6X20 + 2x NUT_M6.

Mass 0.05652 kg x EUR49.44/kg. Process time ESTIMATE (3 min cut+bend) - engineering judgement, not sourced. Welded, no fasteners. CORRECTED 2026-08-22 (v2): material_cost was previously mis-rounded as EUR2.80/total EUR9.79 in v1 - exact value is 0.05652 x 49.44 = 2.7943488 -> EUR2.79, total = 2.7943488 + 6.99 = 9.7843488 -> EUR9.78. Correction reported by Person A during A4 validation cross-check.
manual_calculation.resolution_notes: Welded, not bolted - no fastener cost applies

manual_calculation.calc_notes: Volume = pi x (0.010^2 - 0.005^2) x 0.030 = 0.00000707 m3. Mass = volume x 1410 kg/m3. Process time is an ESTIMATE (5 min simple turning) - not from a source, flagged as engineering judgement.
Mass 0.00716 kg x EUR35.96/kg (sheet stock nylon). Process time ESTIMATE (4 min simple turning) - engineering judgement, not sourced.
Mass 0.01253 kg x EUR421.40/kg (titanium - dominant cost driver despite tiny mass). Process time ESTIMATE (6 min, titanium machines slower than aluminum) - engineering judgement, not sourced.

Mass = 0.00018 m3 x 1600 kg/m3 = 0.288 kg. Material cost dominated by high per-kg composite price (small-quantity retail source, not bulk). Cut length estimated as panel perimeter (2*(0.3+0.2)=1.0m), using straight-cut rate EUR47.5/m; holes for rivet nuts not separately costed. FLAG: this part's total cost is a strong illustration of small-batch sourcing cost inflation for composites - worth discussing in thesis limitations.

manual_calculation.calc_notes: Mass 0.00624 kg x EUR17.98/kg. Process cost = 25 min print time x (EUR12/hr / 60 min) = EUR0.20/min. Print time ESTIMATE - engineering judgement, not sourced.

parts.name: Wiring harness clip
parts.geometry_assumption: small clip, approx 20mm x 15mm x 3mm solid equivalent

manual_calculation.calc_notes: Mass 0.001026 kg x EUR40.00/kg (filament, corrected from sheet-stock mismatch). Process cost = 8 min print time x EUR0.20/min. Print time ESTIMATE - engineering judgement, not sourced. Fastener (roll pin) cost exceeds part material+process cost - small parts dominated by fastener cost, a real BOM finding worth noting.
manual_calculation.resolution_notes: RESOLVED: material_id corrected from NYLON_PA6 (sheet stock) to NYLON_PA6_FILAMENT (3D-print filament) - sheet-vs-filament mismatch found during B4 review, fixed by sourcing real filament pricing (SUP_3DDRUCKSHOPNORD_2026)
